hypothesis.statement: BarunAction candidate-v2 (35M unique parameters, 602/756 on the reused Mobile probe) trails Qwen2.5-0.5B (663/756) and current evidence cannot distinguish whether the gap is driven by parameter count or by pretraining-token budget: BarunLM-35M saw about 5.7e9 pretraining tokens while trillion-token-class small models saw 300-4,500x more. A matched-adaptation sweep over pinned base checkpoints on the identical frozen Mobile Actions SFT recipe, scored on a fresh grouped selection split, separates the two axes.
hypothesis.token_axis: EleutherAI/pythia-70m-deduped (~3e11 pretraining tokens) versus HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M (~2e12 tokens) at near-constant small parameter count.
hypothesis.parameter_axis: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M versus HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-360M (~4e12 tokens) at saturated token budgets, anchored above by the already-measured Qwen2.5-0.5B result (run 20260803-2122-mobile-qwen05b-matched-s17; never rerun) and below by candidate-v2 (never retrained).
hypothesis.decision_this_run_can_change: Which base-model scale, and which axis (tokens versus parameters), the project adopts for the next post-training phase.

decision_rule.reference: BarunAction candidate-v2 evaluated on the fresh selection split in the same run, before any challenger arm is scored, with the identical scorer, greedy decoding, and the frozen 256-token generation budget under the Barun tokenizer. The complete binding is the reference_evaluation section of this config; no CLI or operator-supplied number can substitute for the in-run evaluation.
decision_rule.reference_bias_note: candidate-v2 trained on every selection row (it used the full 7,937-row train set), so its reference score is upward-biased and the +3.0-point margin is conservative for challenger arms, which never train on selection rows.
decision_rule.ordering: ascending unique trainable parameter count; the smallest arm clearing every gate is adopted

axis_interpretation.token_axis_supported: SmolLM2-135M passes while pythia-70m-deduped fails, or the 135M-minus-70M exact-match gap on the selection split is at least 3.0 points.
axis_interpretation.parameter_axis_supported: SmolLM2-360M exceeds SmolLM2-135M by at least 3.0 points on the selection split with both arms clearing validity gates.
axis_interpretation.falsification: If no arm clears the margin over the upward-biased candidate-v2 reference, the scaling hypothesis is falsified at these budgets and candidate-v2 remains the release checkpoint; each axis conclusion is reported explicitly from the pairwise gaps regardless of adoption.

decision_rule.learning_rate_screen_rule: Each arm runs one full fit per learning rate in {1e-4, 3e-5} on the identical sweep-train rows; the fit with the higher selection-split exact-match count is the arm's headline, ties resolved toward the lower learning rate; a fit that fails to complete can never win and two failed fits make the arm a measured failure.

reference_evaluation.checkpoint_pin_source: src/barunaction/candidate.py CANDIDATE_CHECKPOINT_SHA256 (committed authoritative pin, identical to the signed checkpoint_manifest.json of run 20260803-1845-mobile-followup-retry-s17 arm batch63)
reference_evaluation.checkpoint_staging: the launch preamble stages the candidate-v2 checkpoint directory on the remote host and passes its path as --reference-checkpoint; the staging source is irrelevant because every file is verified against the frozen SHA-256 pins (with a signed-manifest cross-check) before any generation, and any mismatch aborts the run
reference_evaluation.verification: barunlm.evaluation.generation.verify_checkpoint with the frozen expected hashes; the checkpoint's own signed checkpoint_manifest.json must agree with the pins when present
reference_evaluation.gold_token_audit_rule: the runner recomputes the barun-16384 gold token audit on both splits from the staged checkpoint's verified tokenizer.json and aborts on drift in any frozen field before the reference generation
reference_evaluation.generation: barunlm.evaluation.generation.generate_manifest: deterministic greedy decoding, batch size and max_new_tokens read from the evaluation section of this config, selection manifest bound by its frozen SHA-256, checkpoint hashes re-verified inside the generation call
reference_evaluation.scoring: barun-mobile-actions-score-v1 write_scores on the identical selection manifest; exact counts consumed from the aggregate's Rate numerators
reference_evaluation.bound_outputs: result.json binds the verified checkpoint file hashes, the reference predictions SHA-256, the full scorer aggregate, the exact counts, and the exact-match percent computed as 100 * ast_exact_match.numerator / rows; the reference predictions and scores are also persisted under export/reference/

data.official_eval_firewall: The runner accepts no source-dataset or official-eval path beyond the frozen train manifest whose preparation audit proves all 961 official rows remained opaque, unparsed, unmaterialized, un-tokenized, and excluded from overlap analysis. fresh_split.derivation_note: No untouched Mobile Actions rows exist outside train/756-dev/961-official (9,654 source rows = 8,693 eligible + 961 sealed; 8,693 = 7,937 train + 756 dev). The fresh selection split is therefore a preregistered grouped holdout of whole connected-component clusters from the frozen 7,937-row train manifest, removed identically from every arm's training data so the matched-budget property is preserved. No arm ever trains on a selection row.
fresh_split.grouping: existing cluster_id connected components (ordered gold tool-name signature plus entity-delexicalized template families joined by MinHash-LSH verified Jaccard >= 0.8 near-duplicate edges), exactly as frozen by barun-mobile-actions-connected-components-v1
fresh_split.hash_rule: sha256(policy_version + ':' + cluster_id), first 8 bytes big-endian, modulo folds; fold 0 is selection
fresh_split.exclusions: none: every one of the 7,937 train rows is assigned to exactly one side; both partition manifests preserve original row order and exact serialized bytes

transport.rule: Every arm is a base (non-chat) checkpoint and receives the byte-identical model-visible prompt used by BarunAction candidate-v2, including the literal role-marker text, encoded with the arm's own pinned tokenizer.json via tokenizers.Tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False). Prompt and target are encoded separately, exactly as at generation time; training appends exactly one native EOS token to the target and supervises only target-plus-EOS positions. Rows whose prompt or target already contains the EOS id abort the run.
transport.termination_contract: The training-appended EOS id must equal the generation stop id and the padding id for every arm (all three are the native <|endoftext|> id 0 for every roster tokenizer). This is the preregistered guard against the SmolLM2-360M-Instruct 0/756 recipe artifact, where generations never emitted the supervised stop token and 407/756 truncated.
transport.chat_template_rule: No chat template is applied anywhere in this sweep; the pinned base checkpoints ship none. The prior matched runs' native-chat transport remains frozen to their own instruct checkpoints.

gold_token_audit.encoding_rule: tokenizers.Tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False) on the pinned tokenizer.json bytes; prompt and target encoded separately
gold_token_audit.max_new_tokens_rule: smallest multiple of 64 at or above (max gold target tokens + 1 EOS + 32 margin) across all audited tokenizers
gold_token_audit.remote_reverification: the GPU runner recomputes the audit per arm (and for the candidate-v2 reference under barun-16384) before training or reference generation and aborts on drift in any frozen field (max_target_tokens_with_eos, prompt_tokens_max, total_with_eos_max) on both splits
gold_token_audit.context_fit: verified on CPU for every audited tokenizer on both splits: longest training row 660 <= 2048 and longest prompt 487 + 256 <= 2048; the prior 192-token budget would have truncated the 197-token Barun-tokenizer gold maximum and is superseded here

optimization.learning_rate_screen_note: preregistered two-point screen per arm replacing the single 2e-05 of the matched instruct lane; each rate is one full fit and the screen is scored only on the fresh selection split
optimization.identical_rows_across_arms: every fit trains on exactly the 7,212 sweep-train rows in the same seed-17 deterministic presentation order over token IDs from its own tokenizer; no arm sees selection rows

fit_failure_semantics.rule: Non-finite training loss or CUDA out-of-memory during one fit's training or generation records that fit as a measured failure (completed=false with the failure class bound into arm-result.json) and the run continues to the next fit. A fit that fails can never win the learning-rate screen; an arm whose every fit failed is a measured arm failure that can never be adopted and is recorded in the decision's measured_failed_arm_ids. If every arm fails, the sweep is falsified by measured failure with no adopted arm. Integrity violations (hash mismatch, optimizer-step budget drift, ID-presentation or gold-audit drift, contract violations) are not measured failures and abort the whole run.

optimization.seed_scope: seed 17 governs the deterministic data presentation order and is additionally installed as the global torch seed (torch.manual_seed and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all) at run start; no stochastic module exists on the honest path (no dropout in any pinned config, greedy decoding, no weight initialization), so the seed claim is exact rather than assumed

evaluation.generation_batch_size_binding: the runner reads the generation batch size from this frozen config; no CLI argument can override it
evaluation.measured_failures: missing predictions, truncations, OOMs, parse failures, and generation failures are counted as failures, never dropped
evaluation.reference_evaluation: candidate-v2 is loaded from its hash-pinned checkpoint and scored once on the same selection manifest with the same scorer, greedy decoding, and 256-token budget before any challenger arm is scored; the complete implementation contract is the top-level reference_evaluation section of this config
evaluation.scoring_join: exact-match, schema-valid, truncation, and missing-prediction counts are consumed from the scorer aggregate's exact Rate numerators (ast_exact_match, schema_valid, truncation, missing_prediction) with denominators required to equal the generated row count; nothing is reconstructed from rounded float products
evaluation.reused_756_probe: descriptive post-hoc reporting only; never a selection metric
evaluation.generation_config_overrides_binding: the runner validates these overrides against the frozen greedy contract at config load and passes every non-null field explicitly to each challenger model.generate call; null fields are sampling-only and stay unset under greedy decoding. Snapshot generation_config.json files are hash-verified where present and pinned-absent otherwise, so no unverified snapshot file can influence decoding
evaluation.environment_binding: result.json records the python, torch, transformers, tokenizers, huggingface_hub, and safetensors versions observed at run time
